This site presents a differential gene expression analysis from CGDS on bulk RNA-seq from 23 individuals diagnosed with ME/CFS. DGE means testing which genes change in mean expression between defined groups while adjusting for batch and other model terms in the statistical design.

Counts come from the [nf-core/rnaseq](https://nf-co.re/rnaseq) pipeline with Salmon quantification; we interpret results in the context of immune and metabolic readouts described in the linked pages.

[workflowr](https://jdblischak.github.io/workflowr/) ties each HTML page to a specific Git commit so the rendered report is the same code and data the authors used.

## Study Design and Differential Expression Results

1. [Background: Study Overview and Methods](background.html)  
2. [Subsetted Differential Gene Expression (DGE) Analysis](subsetted-condition-analysis.html)  
3. [Deconvolution Analysis](deconvolution.html)
4. [Subgroup vs Unaffected DGE Analysis](subgroup-analysis.html) *NOTE: this is in the Supplemental Figures.*

## Results and Data Availability

- Figures, statistics, and annotations from this analysis are presented in the pages above.  
- Input files were generated via Salmon quantification and are located in the `data/star-salmon` directory of the GitHub repository.  
- A single RData file containing key objects from the publication analysis is available: [publication-analysis.RData](https://s3.lts.rc.uab.edu/cgds-public/mecfs-cohort-analysis/publication-analysis.RData).  
  - The file includes DESeq2 objects (`dds`, `vsd`, `counts_vst`, `vsd_limma`) and key result tables (`res_aff_vs_unaff_sub`, `res_aff_vs_unaff_df_padj1_lfc1_sub`, `res_aff_vs_unaff_df_padj05_lfc1_sub`).  
- You can also browse the full source code and workflow on [GitHub](https://github.com/uab-cgds-worthey/mecfs-cohort-analysis).
